mechanism: Fluconazole inhibits CYP3A4, increasing betamethasone metabolism and systemic exposure, while betamethasone may induce fluconazole metabolism through CYP3A4 upregulation.
action: Monitor for increased corticosteroid effects (hyperglycemia, hypertension, immunosuppression) and reduced antifungal efficacy; consider dose adjustments or alternative antifungal if prolonged concurrent use is necessary.
